definitionZh: 剪辑规则CSS属性决定,当路径部分与其他部分重叠时,面具盒中哪些像素在剪辑路径定义的剪辑形状内,哪些在外.
sourceDefinition: The clip-rule CSS property determines, when parts of the path overlap other parts, which pixels in a mask's box are inside the clipping shape defined by a clip path and which are outside.
